name: clip
summary: 11 key moments: ready -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> midair arms wide -> arms overhead -> standing arms down -> arms overhead -> standing arms down (finish)
action: The body repeatedly jumps the legs apart while raising the arms overhead and then back together while lowering the arms.

stages.name: arms overhead
stages.description: The body jumps to spread the legs wide while raising both arms overhead to meet.
stages.measured: left hand up, right hand up

stages.name: standing arms down
stages.description: The body jumps to bring the legs together while lowering both arms down to the sides.
stages.measured: left hand down, right hand down

stages.name: arms overhead
stages.description: The body jumps to spread the legs wide while raising both arms overhead to meet.
stages.measured: left hand up, right hand up

stages.name: standing arms down
stages.description: The body jumps to bring the legs together while lowering both arms down to the sides.
stages.measured: left hand down, right hand down

stages.name: arms overhead
stages.description: The body jumps to spread the legs wide while raising both arms overhead.
stages.measured: left hand up, right hand up

stages.name: standing arms down
stages.description: The body jumps to bring the legs together while lowering both arms down to the sides.
stages.measured: left hand down, right hand down

stages.name: midair arms wide
stages.description: The body lifts off the ground while spreading the legs and raising the arms outward to the sides.

stages.name: arms overhead
stages.description: The body lands with legs spread wide while bringing both arms together overhead.

stages.name: standing arms down
stages.description: The body jumps to bring the legs together while lowering both arms down to the sides.
stages.measured: left hand down, right hand down

stages.name: arms overhead
stages.description: The body jumps to spread the legs wide while raising both arms overhead to meet.
stages.measured: left hand up, right hand up

stages.name: standing arms down (finish)
stages.description: The body jumps to bring the legs together while lowering both arms down to the sides.
stages.measured: left hand down, right hand down (finish)

notes: Progress toward the next key moment pays as it happens, gated on staying upright.
Each key moment reached pays a bonus; a jump pays extra for its height.
Finishing pays a bonus scaled by the moments reached.
Once done, holding the end pose pays per second, and the style terms stop.
A fall gives back what the attempt earned since the last steady stance.
Timing is free: only the order of the moments counts.
Optional moments pay too, but may be skipped.
